# nameslib

## `same_name`

Compares two names ignoring ASCII case.

It is called for every request of the names service, so it must not allocate more than necessary.

prompt: heaptrack says `same_name` (src/lib.rs) churns through short-lived heap allocations. Compares two names ignoring ASCII case. Rewrite it so it allocates (almost) nothing beyond the result. Keep the signature and the output.
